Elden Ring early-game Samurai build guide

Game: Elden Ring. Edition: base game.

This Elden Ring guide is for a Samurai at the beginning of the base game, immediately after leaving the tutorial area for Limgrave. It describes an early-game Samurai blade build, using the starting Uchigatana katana. It does not cover Shadow of the Erdtree or other expansion content.

Starting weapon and combat

The Samurai starts with an Uchigatana katana and a longbow. Keep the Uchigatana as the main blade for this early-game build. Its starting Unsheathe skill provides a quick katana attack; use it after an enemy misses, then recover stamina before attacking again. Ordinary blade attacks and careful dodges are enough to learn early encounters. The longbow can pull one enemy away from a group.

Basic stats

The Samurai begins with 12 Vigor, 13 Endurance, 12 Strength, and 15 Dexterity. The Uchigatana requires 11 Strength and 15 Dexterity, so the starting Samurai can already use it. Prioritize Vigor toward 20 for early survival, then add Endurance if stamina or equipment load limits you. Put later points into Dexterity toward 20 as you continue a katana build. Avoid spreading early levels across Intelligence, Faith, and Arcane for this simple blade setup.

Upgrades and progression

Collect ordinary Smithing Stones while exploring Limgrave and upgrade the Uchigatana at a smithing table or blacksmith. Improving the starting weapon is a useful early step before pursuing another blade. Keep the starting armor if it allows a medium equipment load, and remove a piece if necessary to keep the medium dodge. Stay near the beginning areas after the tutorial and learn katana spacing before moving deeper into the game. This progression keeps the build focused on one upgraded Uchigatana, Vigor for survival, and Dexterity for later blade investment.
